title: StageRecord
description: One stage as the document stores it.

version.description: The version of the stage's contract: which schema its settings and output follow.

depends_on.description:
The hash of the input the stage read, so staleness can be worked out on load. Absent until
the stage has run.

settings.description: The settings the stage ran with (or will run with).

output.description: What the stage returned. Absent until the stage has run.

centreline.description: The river centreline, from the mouth when one is stated.

design_line.description: The design line the later stages read.

given_water.description:
The water level profile of the inputs, on river chainage: the open river below the lowest
structure.

channel_width_m.description:
The channel width sent to the structures tool, and the tolerance of a site given as a point
(half of it): the sizing's bottom width on a straight, metres.

step_m.description:
The step, metres of design-line chainage, at which the line is searched for each site
before bisection.

Polyline.description: A line in the project CRS: `[x, y]` points in order.

WaterProfile.description:
The water level along a river: points sorted by chainage, read linearly between points and held
flat beyond the first and last. Two points at one chainage make a step (a weir): at that chainage
the later point holds.

WaterPoint.description:
One point of a water level profile: a river chainage and the level there, in metres. It is
written as the pair `[chainage, level]`.

Structures.description:
The `inputs.structures` block: the structures and the rule for minimum and maximum pool levels.
Absent: no weirs or locks.

items.description: The given structures, in any order.

pool_levels.description:
The rule for minimum and maximum pool levels. Written out in full when stored, so a later
change of default never changes what a stored design meant.

StructuresMode.description: How the structures are found. Only `given` today; the search over candidate sites is ticket 15.

kind.description: Weir, lock, or both. A weir when not given.

upstream_level_m.description: The mean water level it holds upstream: its pool's design level, metres above datum.

oneOf.description: A weir: it holds the pool; vessels do not pass it.
A weir with a lock beside it.

Site.description: Where a structure is: a river chainage from the mouth, or a point in the project CRS.

oneOf.description: River chainage from the mouth, metres.

A point `[x, y]` in the project CRS. It must lie within half the channel width of the design
line; its river chainage is where it projects onto the river centreline.

Chainage.description:
Distance along a river or a design line, in metres. Chainage 0 is at the river mouth when the river
states one (spec 0017); with no mouth stated, it is at the start of the line as it was given.

Money.description:
An amount of money and its currency.

An amount is checked when it is made (`Money::new`) and again when it is read from JSON.

amount.description: The amount, in the currency's main unit.

PoolLevelRule.description:
How a pool's minimum and maximum levels follow from its level: an allowance below and above,
one pair for the run.

below_m.description: The minimum level is the pool's level less this, metres. Navigation depth is checked there.

above_m.description: The maximum level is the pool's level plus this, metres. Flood risk is checked there.

pools.description: The pools, from the mouth; pool k is held by structure k.

pool_levels.description: The rule the minimum and maximum levels came from.

currency.description: The currency of every structure's cost.

id.description: Its place in the input's list.

chainage.description:
Design-line chainage: where the design line's projection onto the river first reaches the
structure's river chainage (where the water stage puts the step).

point.description: Its site on the design line.

downstream_level_m.description: The level below it: the next pool down, or the open river below the lowest.

footprint.description: From the structures tool, when it gives one.

source.description: Where the height, footprint and cost come from.

RiverPolygon.description:
The river as water: an outer ring and the islands cut out of it. A ring is a [`Polyline`] that is
closed by implication (the last point joins the first).

holes.description: Islands: each is dry land inside the shell.

StructureSource.description: Where a structure's height, footprint and cost come from.

oneOf.description: A structures tool worked them out.

PlannedPool.description: One pool: from a structure up to the next one (or to the end of the river).

held_by.description: The structure that holds it: its index in the plan's `structures`.

river_from.description: River chainage where it starts (at its structure).

level_m.description: Its design level: the upstream level of its structure.

min_level_m.description: Its level less the allowance below.

max_level_m.description: Its level plus the allowance above.
